_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.
Deliver the barrel to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.
Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.

Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants you to bring him the bottles of Pupellyverbos Port he lost.

Bring Maury's Clubbed Foot, Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, and Chucky's Huge Ring to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

Slay King Mukla and return to Princess Poobah with the Key to free her.
Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.

Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones. Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus. Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains…

Bring 12 of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Speak to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.
Kill 10 Marsh Murlocs, 10 Marsh Inkspewer, and 10 Marsh Flesheater, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Kill 10 Marsh Inkspewers, 10 Marsh Flesheaters, and 10 Marsh Oracles, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the Badlands. Once you have them filled, bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.t: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman. From the journal, you…
Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.

Claim your reward from Galvan the Ancient!
Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Speak with Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.
Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.
Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.
Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.
Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.
Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.
Take the Torch of Retribution.
Speak with Squire Maltrake.
Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
Open the chest.
If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.
Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.
If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.
Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.
Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.
Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.
Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

o.t: Place the Bait in front of Miblon Snarltooth.

quests.t: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.
Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

quests.n: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
quests.t: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chem…
Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.
Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.
Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.
Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

quests.n: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.t: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries. Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldier…
Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius. Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Se…
Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems. The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge. Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed…

quests.n: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
quests.t: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs. You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge. Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge…

quests.t: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge. The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere…

Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse. Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete. Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete. Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete. Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend…

Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete. Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete. You can find the Highvale high…

Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete. Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of th…

quests.n: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
quests.t: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task i…

Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete. Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'wa…

Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor. You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern…
Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.
Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor. Markhor mentioned that his brother's remai…
Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

quests.n: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
quests.t: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete. Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Ji…

quests.n: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
quests.t: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters. Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village…
Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.

Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat. Kill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
You will need to hand in 25 books to complete this quest, however you can hand 1 in at any time.
